faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I download a YouTube video?
faq.a1: Simply paste the YouTube URL into the input box and click download. Choose your preferred format and quality, then click download again.
faq.q2: Does MediaGrabber support TikTok downloads without watermark?
faq.a2: Yes, MediaGrabber supports TikTok video downloads in high quality without watermarks, depending on the source availability.
faq.q3: Can I download Instagram reels and audio?
faq.a3: Yes, you can download Instagram reels, photos, and extract audio in MP3 format.
faq.a4: Yes, MediaGrabber is 100% free. No registration, no hidden fees, no ads.
faq.q5: Is it safe to use MediaGrabber?
faq.a5: Yes, MediaGrabber is completely safe. We don't store any of your personal information or downloads.
faq.a6: We support MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV for videos and MP3, FLAC, AAC, OGG for audio.
